purpose: Diagnose the already-observed RA01 root-uptake uncertainty floor using only persisted RA01 evidence. No new hydraulic or root-active simulation is authorized.

evidence_scope.optimization: o0 only; RA01 already proved O0/O2 byte identity
evidence_scope.root_records: LAREDYN0R_ROOT at the common 0.0008-day observation grid

feddes_contract.rule: h3 is interpolated in pressure-head space exactly as mod_root_water_uptake_process::critical_hlim3; 10-cm profile means are converted to an effective-saturation proxy only.

preregistered_diagnostics.bit_and_ulp: Report exact-equality counts, maximum absolute differences and IEEE-754 ULP distances for each root-response field.
preregistered_diagnostics.aggregation_roundoff_reference: For each pair and observation, report whether ACTUAL_RATE difference exceeds [gamma(nroot_A)+gamma(nobs_A)+gamma(nroot_B)+gamma(nobs_B)]*PTRA, with gamma(k)=k*eps/(1-k*eps). This is a non-fitted arithmetic reference, not an acceptance tolerance.
preregistered_diagnostics.threshold_proxy: Count 10-cm bin-mean effective-saturation straddles of h4 and the demand-specific h3 threshold across each route pair.
preregistered_diagnostics.response_class: Report whether paired ACTUAL_FRACTION values differ in exact full-potential status (value exactly 1.0); do not treat this alone as node-level regime evidence.

classifications.AVAILABLE_OUTPUT_SUPPORTS_NUMERICAL_FLOO: Zero bin-mean threshold straddles and zero ACTUAL_RATE differences above the preregistered aggregation-roundoff reference.
classifications.THRESHOLD_EFFECT_PLAUSIBLE_AT_BIN_SCALE: At least one rooted-bin mean straddles h3 or h4 across a compared route pair at a common observation.
classifications.NODE_LEVEL_ADJUDICATION_UNAVAILABLE: Always true unless persisted evidence contains node-level pressure head or drought-reduction factors. RA01 does not.

next_rule: If available-output evidence supports a numerical floor but node-level adjudication remains unavailable, preregister a separate RA02-D2 diagnostic that emits node-level Feddes regime information on the frozen Reference only. If bin-scale threshold straddles occur, retain the Reference blocker until a node-level diagnostic resolves them.
